category_edits.rationale: Expand each SASRec block's feed-forward intermediate width to 4× the hidden dimension to increase token-wise nonlinear capacity. Preserve activation, dropout, output width, residuals, attention, embeddings, scoring, loss and optimizer. The embedded predictor writer already imports SASRec from train.py, so it reconstructs the widened architecture and loads matching checkpoints without additional edits.

response.change_summary: Widen SASRec feed-forward intermediate layers from H to 4H for all four category models, with predictor compatibility preserved through its existing architecture import.
